description: Insert blank pages into a PDF — at the start, at the end, or after any page. Choose page size and how many to add.

faqs.a: Yes — Letter, A4, A3, Legal and Tabloid are available, or match the size of the PDF's first page.
faqs.q: What blank page sizes are available?

faqs.a: Blank pages are inserted after that page number, pushing the rest of the document down.
Up to 100 blank pages per run — plenty for note-taking space.
faqs.q: How many blank pages can I add?

faqs.a: No — everything is processed locally in your browser.

howto: Pick where to insert: start, end, or after a page.
Choose the blank page size and count.
